notes.title: March 8 2025 Update Notes
notes.content:
General bug fixes and adjustments to difficulty settings:
-Increased Convoy limit to 250

-Save Shrines may now be used repeatedly

-Prayer Book has additional uses at lower difficulties

-“Fury” is no longer considered a bad status effect and is not blocked by the Ward Ring, etc.

-Fixed bug causing certain units to become “deselected” on a reloaded Battle Prep screen

-Implemented the following changes in the game's difficulty settings:
1) Added a new, easier difficulty setting (the new "Casual" setting)
2) Made adjustments to the former "Casual" and "Easy" settings to reduce difficulty (mainly reduced enemy counts on certain maps)
3) EXP gain rate has been adjusted on the former "Casual" and "Easy" settings
4) Difficulty levels have been renamed:
     "Casual" is now "Casual+"
     "Easy" is now "Moderate"
     "Normal" is now "Classic"
5) Updated written descriptions for the difficulty levels
